format.geometry: Content geometry inside a widget card (addendum A5), in px: the start inset of an editable grid widget (one 24px row handle plus its gap) and of every other widget, the end and top insets, the compact row handle, a one-line grid row (min height plus its bottom divider), and the inset of a list widget's row titles.
format.list_title_inset: From the start edge of the widget card to the start of a list row's title cell (the row icon when the row shows one, else the title text): the 40px row-actions slot, which a read-only widget keeps empty, plus the 6px row padding and the 2px title inset. The same for an editable and a read-only list widget, in View and Edit mode.
